title: Expats In Lyon
author: Sami Chidiac
description: A weekly Podcast by Expats for Expats about the beautiful City of Lights. By alternating between interviews with Expats and fascinating stories about Lyon, we hope this podcast will help you fall in love with the city the way we fell in love with it. Instagram: @ExpatsInLyon Facebook page: The Expats in Lyon Podcast
